channel.title: US Housing Lottery HOT
channel.description: Public lotteries from NYC Housing Connect, San Francisco DAHLIA, Los Angeles Access Housing LA, San Jose Housing Portal and Boston Metrolist: sorted by deadline, showing only our own paraphrased titles and one-line summaries, city, unit count, deadline and the official application link — no republished originals.

item.title: Brooklyn lottery ends today: 16 affordable rentals, mostly two-bedrooms
item.description: Last day today: 16 affordable rentals in Brooklyn, mostly two-bedrooms, so families should check the income bands and apply before the window closes tonight.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Brooklyn lottery ends today: 19 affordable rentals, studios to three-bedrooms
item.description: Also closing today: 19 Brooklyn rentals spanning studios to three-bedrooms, a rare mix that suits singles and larger households alike, but the window shuts tonight.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery ends today: 30 affordable rentals, including extremely low income homes
item.description: Closing today and worth a look: 30 Bronx rentals, including homes set aside for extremely low and very low incomes, a band that rarely gets this many openings at once.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery closes tomorrow: 17 affordable rentals, all low income
item.description: One day left: 17 Bronx rentals, all in the low-income band, with a good share of one-bedrooms for singles and couples; apply tomorrow at the latest.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Queens lottery closes tomorrow: 6 affordable rentals, all family-sized
item.description: One day left in Queens: only 6 homes, all two- and three-bedrooms for families, so expect stiff competition and apply early rather than at the deadline.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Queens lottery closes tomorrow: 12 two-bedroom affordable rentals
item.description: One day left: 12 two-bedroom rentals in Queens, all low income, a clean fit for a small family that needs a second bedroom without a market rent.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Brooklyn lottery closes tomorrow: 18 affordable rentals, mostly one-bedrooms
item.description: One day left in Brooklyn: 18 rentals, mostly one-bedrooms, all low income; a solid option for a single renter who wants a below-market one-bedroom.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Brooklyn lottery closes in two days: only 3 affordable rentals
item.description: Two days left, but only 3 homes in Brooklyn, so treat this one as a long shot and put your main effort into the larger openings closing the same week.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: New York lottery closes in two days: 18 affordable rentals, all low income
item.description: Two days left: 18 affordable rentals in New York City, all low income, with studios through two-bedrooms; a balanced mix for singles and small families.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Queens lottery closes in two days: 4 two-bedroom affordable rentals
item.description: Two days left in Queens: just 4 two-bedroom homes, all low income; small opening, so apply if it fits and do not count on it alone.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Manhattan lottery closes in two days: 20 affordable rentals for moderate incomes
item.description: Two days left in Manhattan: 20 rentals for moderate incomes, with one-, two- and three-bedrooms; Manhattan openings are rare, so moderate-income households should not let this one pass.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery closes in two days: only 3 two-bedroom affordable rentals
item.description: Two days left in the Bronx: only 3 two-bedroom homes, all low income; a small opening best treated as an extra entry alongside bigger lotteries.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery open for five more days: 6 affordable rentals
item.description: Five days left in the Bronx: 6 low-income rentals with a studio, one- and two-bedrooms; no rush today, but set a reminder, since five days pass quickly.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Brooklyn mega lottery: 217 affordable rentals, a week left to apply
item.description: The biggest opening this week: 217 Brooklyn rentals, a week left to apply, with homes for extremely low, very low and low incomes and every bedroom size; if you can only apply to one lottery, make it this one.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: Bronx lottery open until December 18: 6 affordable rentals
item.description: The longest runway on the board: a Bronx lottery open until December 18, with 6 low-income one- and two-bedrooms; no urgency this week, so check the income bands carefully and apply when ready.
item.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries

item.title: San Francisco lottery closes in two days: 62 brand-new affordable rentals
item.description: Two days left: this 62-home new rental opening is the biggest San Francisco lottery open right now. Check the income band first and apply before the deadline-night rush.
item.source: San Francisco DAHLIA Listings

item.title: San Francisco waitlist closes December 2: only 2 affordable rentals
item.description: Just 2 homes, and this one is a waitlist rather than a lottery, so expect a long queue — only join if the income band fits.
item.source: San Francisco DAHLIA Listings

item.title: San Francisco waitlist closes December 4: 37 affordable rentals
item.description: 37 homes on a waitlist closing December 4. A waitlist rewards queue position, not luck, so register early if the income band fits.
item.source: San Francisco DAHLIA Listings

item.title: San Francisco lottery closes December 9: 21 brand-new affordable rentals
item.description: 21 brand-new rentals in a standard lottery closing December 9. A good fit for households hoping for a new building — check the income band first.
item.source: San Francisco DAHLIA Listings

item.title: One senior rental left in San Jose: first-come deadline December 1
item.description: Just 1 senior home left, first-come not a lottery, closing December 1. If the household qualifies, apply now — there is nothing to wait for.
item.source: San Jose Housing Portal
